sentence: Clean up the backyard and trim the hibiscus shrubs along the pool cage.

evidence.note: Chain-link fence visible along the left side of the yard, but no gate opening is visible in frame to judge width.

observation.model_notes: Photo 1 shows an in-ground pool inside a screened lanai/pool cage, while Photo 2 shows a different-looking backyard (open lawn, shed, wood deck, and what appears to be a separate above-ground/deck-set pool visible through the deck railing). The two photos may not be the same section of the same property, or may even be from different visits — the scope should confirm this before quoting. Photo 2 does not show the hibiscus/pool-cage bed up close, so the yard_cleanup severity call is based mainly on the general lawn condition in Photo 2, not on close inspection of the bed area itself. Neither photo shows the side yard, so side-yard conditions are unknown.

supporting_evidence.note: Lawn strip in front of the pool cage looks green, mowed, and free of debris.

evidence.note: Open backyard lawn is mowed with visible mower stripes; some brown/dry patches present but no leaves, sticks, or debris piled up.
Lawn near the pool enclosure is green and tidy, no visible debris or overgrowth outside the planting bed.

service_lines.uncertain: Only two photos are available and neither shows the full backyard up close, so overall debris/clutter levels elsewhere in the yard aren't confirmed.

counting_evidence.note: Counted roughly 6 distinct hibiscus canopies: one large shrub with pale pink blooms at the far left, and about 5 more shrubs with red/pink/yellow blooms forming a row along the pool cage screen toward the right.

evidence.note: Hibiscus shrubs are flowering and have grown tall and wide against the screen enclosure, some branches reaching/touching the pool cage mesh.

service_lines.uncertain: The shrubs along the right side form a continuous hedge with overlapping canopies, so the exact plant count is approximate rather than exact.
